description: Send a task to a human for screening and a fixed-price quote. Not binding. Answer within 24 hours. Returns quote_id, access_token, response_due_at, nda_url (one-way NDA for operators who need a signed one) and upload_url (POST input files there instead of a URL in input_files or an e-mail attachment; see /llms.txt). No authentication. The most commonly forgotten field: if deliverables involves shipping, handing over or collecting a physical item, always also fill task.delivery_address (one plain string: name, street, city, postcode, country, and phone only if you already have it - phone is optional, never stop to ask the user for one) - do not skip it and do not report it as sent unless it is actually in the arguments below. If the user gives only a company name and an address, use the company name as client.name and the address's country as client.country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2); no VAT/company ID or other client detail is needed. For a physical deliverable, always also fill task.delivery_address (phone there is optional - never stop to ask the user for one). Example of a complete, valid request: {"task":{"description":"3D-print 2 pcs of bracket.stl in black PETG, check the 3 hole distances, ship to the address below.","services":["make","ship"],"deliverables":"2 parts delivered; photos; measured hole distances.","deadline":"2026-10-15","delivery_address":"Example GmbH, Musterstr. 1, 10115 Berlin, DE, +49 30 000000","input_files":["https://example.com/bracket.stl"],"currency":"EUR"},"client":{"email":"ops@example.com","name":"Example Inc.","country":"US"},"agent":{"name":"procurement-agent (Example Inc.)"},"allow_anonymised_example":false}

name.description: Name of the agent or platform sending the request. Optional, for our records.

allow_anonymised_example.description: Consent to publish this task as an anonymised example (no names, addresses or personal data), under the confidentiality section of the terms of service. Only set true if the client explicitly agreed to this; otherwise omit the field or leave it false. Default false; can be withdrawn.

country.description: Country of the operator, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (upper case).

email.description: E-mail of the operator. The quote, the payment link and the invoice go here.

name.description: Full name of the person, or registered name of the company, that operates the agent.

vat_id.description: VAT or tax id of the operator, printed on the invoice. Optional.

currency.description: Currency of the quote. Default EUR.

deadline.description: Latest acceptable delivery or dispatch date (ISO 8601). Optional; omit if the user gave none.

deliverables.description: What you expect to receive (item, files, report, photos, video).

delivery_address.description: Required whenever deliverables describes a physical item to be shipped, packed and collected, or handed over in person - omit only for purely digital deliverables (files, a report). One plain string with name, street, city, postcode and country, in that order; add a phone number at the end only if you already have one. Phone is optional - if you already have a name and an address, never stop to ask the user for a phone number. Not an object and not a list of lines.

description.description: What is to be done, in plain language. Include quantities, materials, tolerances and what counts as done.

input_files.description: HTTPS URLs of input files, for example photos, a sketch, a CAD model (STEP, STL), a PDF drawing, or other instructions, or attach the files to the e-mail. At most 20, each at most 2000 characters.

services.description: Service ids from the service list, if you know them.

name: request_quote
